// Run as an external caller of unmodified SourceCommit, with a new output dir.
package main

import (
	"encoding/json"
	"errors"
	"os"
	"path/filepath"
	"time"

	"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/raft/raft"
	"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/raft/types"
	"github.com/WuKongIM/WuKongIM/pkg/wkdb"
)

func must(err error) {
	if err != nil {
		panic(err)
	}
}

func main() {
	dir := os.Args[1]
	must(os.Mkdir(dir, 0700))
	open := func() wkdb.DB {
		db := wkdb.NewWukongDB(wkdb.NewOptions(wkdb.WithDir(filepath.Join(dir, "db")), wkdb.WithNodeId(1), wkdb.WithShardNum(2)))
		must(db.Open())
		return db
	}
	db := open()
	at := time.Unix(1700000000, 0).UTC()
	for _, id := range []struct {
		ID   string
		Type uint8
	}{{"zero-version", 1}, {"type-zero", 0}, {"", 0}} {
		must(db.SaveChannelClusterConfig(wkdb.ChannelClusterConfig{ChannelId: id.ID, ChannelType: id.Type, LeaderId: 1, Term: 1, ReplicaMaxCount: 3, Replicas: []uint64{1, 2, 3}, ConfVersion: 0, CreatedAt: &at}))
	}
	_, err := db.AddChannel(wkdb.ChannelInfo{ChannelId: "", ChannelType: 0, CreatedAt: &at})
	must(err)
	// Reopen to bypass write-populated caches and exercise original column reads.
	must(db.Close())
	db = open()
	result := map[string]any{}
	for _, id := range []struct {
		Name, ID string
		Type     uint8
	}{{"zero_version", "zero-version", 1}, {"type_zero", "type-zero", 0}, {"empty", "", 0}} {
		cfg, err := db.GetChannelClusterConfig(id.ID, id.Type)
		if err != nil && !errors.Is(err, wkdb.ErrNotFound) {
			panic(err)
		}
		result[id.Name] = map[string]any{"found": err == nil, "version": cfg.ConfVersion, "leader": cfg.LeaderId, "term": cfg.Term, "channel_type": cfg.ChannelType, "empty": wkdb.IsEmptyChannelClusterConfig(cfg)}
	}
	info, err := db.GetChannel("", 0)
	must(err)
	exists, err := db.ExistChannel("", 0)
	must(err)
	listed, err := db.SearchChannels(wkdb.ChannelSearchReq{Limit: 100})
	must(err)
	listedEmpty := false
	for _, row := range listed {
		if row.ChannelId == "" {
			listedEmpty = true
		}
	}
	result["empty_channel_info"] = map[string]any{"physical_id_nonzero": info.Id != 0, "empty": wkdb.IsEmptyChannelInfo(info), "exists": exists, "search_lists_empty": listedEmpty}
	listedCfg, err := db.GetChannelClusterConfigs(0, 100)
	must(err)
	listedEmpty = false
	for _, row := range listedCfg {
		if row.ChannelId == "" {
			listedEmpty = true
		}
	}
	result["config_directory_lists_empty"] = listedEmpty
	must(db.Close())
	n := raft.NewNode(0, types.RaftState{}, raft.NewOptions(raft.WithNodeId(1), raft.WithKey("zero-version-1")))
	cfg := types.Config{Version: 0, Term: 1, Leader: 1, Replicas: []uint64{1, 2, 3}, Role: types.RoleLeader}
	must(n.Step(types.Event{Type: types.ConfChange, Config: cfg}))
	result["raft_zero_version"] = map[string]any{"leader": n.IsLeader(), "version": n.Config().Version, "term": n.Config().Term}
	cfg.Version = 5
	must(n.Step(types.Event{Type: types.ConfChange, Config: cfg}))
	cfg.Version = 0
	err = n.Step(types.Event{Type: types.ConfChange, Config: cfg})
	result["raft_downgrade"] = map[string]any{"step_returns_error": err != nil, "retained_version": n.Config().Version}
	data, err := json.MarshalIndent(result, "", "  ")
	must(err)
	must(os.WriteFile(filepath.Join(dir, "observations.json"), append(data, '\n'), 0600))
}
